query: Broadcom AI semiconductor revenue most recent quarter

output.content: Broadcom’s most recently reported AI semiconductor revenue was **$16.7 billion in fiscal Q3 2026**, the quarter ended **August 2, 2026**; it rose **221% year over year** and **54% sequentially**. [[1]]
